p: I am avowed from you, … I am separated from you, … I am distanced from you, … That … I eat … yours, … That
I am avowed from you, or: I am separated from you, or: I am distanced from you, and he then says: That which I eat of yours, or: That
Rabbi Akiva was uncertain … to rule stringently about this
Rabbi Akiva was uncertain about this halakha but was inclined to rule stringently about this
